search_f_gold: search for a target value x in array arr up to n elements and return its index
test_f_gold: test the f_gold linear search function against multiple parameter sets and count successes
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function which performs linear search with O(n) asymptotic complexity
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold linear search function to use binary search for sorted arrays
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that finds the first occurrence of x in arr
